finding: ChatGPT Images needs the reference image to exist as an attachment in the generator conversation. A Drive connector fetch can verify/read bytes but is not a reliable visual-reference binding path for image generation. A native ChatGPT Library file can be added to a conversation and therefore provides a reusable attachment path without repeated device re-upload.

canonical_reference.source: Copied from the canonical R1C bytes already present in the project conversation.

runtime_reference_priority: Add canonical R1C from ChatGPT Library to the fresh generator conversation.
If Library attachment is unavailable in the current client, directly upload the same canonical file to the fresh generator conversation.
Do not use Drive connector fetch as the image-generation reference binding path.
generator_rule: The image must visibly appear in the fresh chat as a current-conversation attachment before ChatGPT Images is invoked.
